title: Declare the Loop 5, 8, 9 and 11 controllers and wire their runtime env
objective: Declare agora_interaction_evidence, promotion_deployment, capital_pool_execution and evolution as implemented catalog controllers using the names the merged writers record, and give the three writers the env they read.

owned: docs/deployment/loop-catalog.registry.json: controller_contract and current_controller_owner for agora-interaction-worker, deployment-outbox-consumer, paper-fleet-reconciler, evolution-dispatch-worker. Queries are the writers' own source labels (agora.interaction_lifecycle_store.claim / agora.interaction_worker.outcomes, deployment.outbox.claim / deployment.outbox_consumer.run_poll, runtime-manager.runtime-fleet.desired-state / paper-fleet-reconciler.worker_inventory, evolution.dispatch_outbox).

docker-compose.yml: DATABASE_URL on deployment-outbox-consumer, RECONCILER_LOOP_CONTROLLER_DSN on paper-fleet-reconciler (the dedicated DSN var the writer reads and strips from worker envs), PANTHEON_TENANT_ID on evolution-dispatch-worker. No other env change.

scripts/run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py: evolution-dispatch-worker added to the waited REQUIRED_COMPOSE_SERVICES; scripts/test_run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py fails if any controller writer service is removed from the harness lists.
scripts/test_loop_writer_image_contracts.py: CASES cover the four new writers.
Bff contract tests: four runtime bindings (compose_services empty), twelve declared / one undeclared (composite overlay).
not_changing: Any writer, admission or projector code.

design_notes: evolution-dispatch-worker is waited: its healthcheck passes after one error-free poll, and in a fresh stack the dispatch outbox is empty and the evolution service is already in the waited set. Not executed in a fresh Compose stack in this task; the operator verifies the next FULL Management readback.
agora-interaction-worker was already in STIMULUS_COMPOSE_SERVICES; deployment-outbox-consumer and paper-fleet-reconciler were already in REQUIRED_COMPOSE_SERVICES.
No Compose service sets PANTHEON_CONTROLLER_NAME for the four writers, so compose_services is empty and the reverse-direction check is unchanged.
The 'undeclared' record_kind case of the health-metadata test is removed: no canonical loop is undeclared any more and the composite overlay has no loop-health detail route.
